data.body: [operator-attested] Plan-review evidence refresh: exact no-RAM control run 31868300174 checked out patchset commit 1129f50 and executed 13,397 passed / 65 skipped default plus 158 passed / 11 skipped integration under runner.temp. Treatment run 31869753711 executed the same default selector and identical 13,397 / 65 collection under /Volumes/RebarTests, so the primary comparison is collection-matched; later independent treatments corroborate direction. The predeclared retention threshold recorded before the treatments was the larger of 5% or the observed recent-green range. Against 17m26s default and 20m36s job, the 5% floor required at most 16m33.7s default and 19m34.2s job. All treatments missed it. Hosted logs for 31869753711, 31869919362, 31870391571, and successful final run 31873067707 show the RAM device mounted at /Volumes/RebarTests, outside /tmp and /var/folders; no tmp-cleaner deletion occurred during 18-21 minute default tiers. The actual failure was separately traced to owner-nonwritable snapshot fixtures during explicit recursive cleanup, then repaired and replicated green. Existing workflow consumers test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_extra_coverage_guard.py, and test_worktree_python_pin.py remained unchanged and passed within the full Gerrit Verify suite.
